host: Apple M4 Max, 64 GiB, CPU backend, ambient load (not a 32 GB measurement; memory was explicitly not a gate for this round)

findings.gates: no artifact meets the accuracy or false-pass gate; CPU latency fails the warm p95 gate on all three (Metal met it for the 14B in the partial run)
findings.scaling: 14B -> 32B (2.3x weights) moved accuracy 0.82 -> 0.84 and false passes 9 -> 8; the MoE regressed to 0.74 with 11 false alarms. The false-pass id set is stable across all three artifacts (bt-029; at-001/007/013/019/021 in every run)
findings.false_pass_anatomy: at-001/007/013/019 are abstention_trap variant 1 (a planned stage's result absent while build and deploy exit=0) and the question asks whether the FINAL stage passed - deploy is the final stage and passed, so the case wording is ambiguous; at-003/015/021 ('stage X: SUCCESS' with no exit evidence) and bt-009/019/029 ('PASS (exit=1)') are the text-vs-data class where deterministic exit-code parsing must own truth
findings.implication: model choice inside this instrument cannot reach the gates; the gates must be measured on the product contract (structured diagnosis with completeness computed in code and deterministic exit parsing), and variant-1 cases need an unambiguous question before they count as false passes
findings.coder: Qwen3-Coder-30B-A3B-Instruct Q4_K_M is the best artifact so far: 0.847, 7 false passes, fact_extraction and jenkins_label 40/40, build_triage 41/48 with ZERO false passes (the 'PASS (exit=1)' text-vs-data class is solved by the coder tuning). Every remaining false pass is an abstention_trap variant: at-001/007/013/019 (variant 1, ambiguous 'final stage' wording) and at-003/015/021 (variant 3, 'SUCCESS' with no exit evidence). With variant 1 reworded the coder would sit at 3 false passes, all of them the no-exit-evidence class that deterministic parsing must own.
findings.not_loadable: Qwen3-Coder-Next (qwen3_next), Qwen3.6/3.8 variants and gpt-oss-20b/120b need architectures the runtime does not have (candle-transformers 0.9.2 ships no gpt-oss or qwen3_next quantized model); the runtime loads only qwen3 and qwen3moe GGUFs.
